title: teucrium commune proles rouyanum
intro: Teucrium commune proles rouyanum, commonly known as Alpine Germander or Rouy's Teucrium, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb with various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Germander include its use in treating digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions, due to its spasmolytic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Teucrium commune proles rouyanum include diterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
